description: Calculate prior-year and exact five-year changes for one final annual USDA NASS national crop series. Returns component observations, absolute and percent changes, five-year CAGR when valid, exact units, evidence hash, and caveats. Use this for 'how has corn yield changed?', 'five-year soybean production trend', or 'trend in upland cotton planted acres'. The optional as-of year never mixes future releases into a historical result.

as_of_year.description: Four-digit crop year. Hosted snapshot coverage is 2019–2025.

crop.description: Crop name or supported alias: corn, soybeans, cotton, wheat, winter wheat, durum wheat, or spring wheat.

crop_class.description: Optional class. Required for bare 'wheat': winter, durum, or spring (excluding durum).

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: usda_nass_crop_trend
